Main /api/auth/login (admin/teacher123) works out of the box. Frontend: /substitution/login → dashboard with all sub-* testids present including the previously-missing sub-nav-home. End-to-end substitution flow verified on Monday 2026-10-26: absent teacher selected (زاهر), period grid rendered correctly (yellow=needs sub / green=assigned / disabled=free), candidate list shown with ranking chips (أقل احتياط, أقل نصاب, يُدرِس هذا الصف), manual تكليف turned period 4 green and appended a row to the sub-report. minor.issue: Tests hard-code PDF_PATH='/tmp/supervision.pdf' which is not shipped with the repo. Not a runtime bug — only a test-fixture omission. Suggest guarding with pytest.skip(reason='fixture PDF missing') when the file is absent.

action_items: OPTIONAL: In /app/backend/tests/test_supervision.py, guard test_1_import_pdf and test_7_delete_and_reimport with pytest.skip(...) if /tmp/supervision.pdf does not exist, so the suite reports 47/47 instead of 47/49 on fresh imports.
OPTIONAL: Ship a sample supervision PDF under /app/backend/tests/fixtures/ and update PDF_PATH to reference it, so supervision-import coverage isn't lost.
critical_code_review_comments: backend/substitution.py::init() only seeds the substitution admin user when both SUB_ADMIN_USERNAME and SUB_ADMIN_PASSWORD env vars are set — otherwise the login /api/substitution/auth/login returns 401 with no way to bootstrap. On a fresh /app clone (like this branch import) /app/backend/.env did NOT contain these vars, so the substitution system was un-loginnable until I added them. Recommend either (a) documenting these as required in memory/test_credentials.md AND the initial .env template, or (b) falling back to a hard-coded default seed (ehtiyat/ehtiyat2026) when the env vars are missing so the system self-bootstraps on first run. Currently there is a silent gap between test_credentials.md (which promises ehtiyat/ehtiyat2026) and reality.

backend/.env in the shipped repo had NO trailing newline after CORS_ORIGINS="*", so appending SUB_ADMIN_USERNAME on the same line produced a python-dotenv parse warning ('could not parse statement starting at line 3'). Not fatal but worth fixing by ensuring the repo's .env ends with \n.
substitution.py is now 917 lines (was 498 in iteration_10). It has grown past the 700-line soft cap. Consider splitting into modules: auth, teachers, day, stats, export, supervision, settings.
frontend/src/components/substitution/SubLayout.jsx: previous iteration_10 flagged the sub-nav-home testid mismatch — this is now FIXED (verified 'sub-nav-home' present in DOM). Good.
Frontend uses react-router v6 with future flags NOT enabled — two console warnings on every load. Enable v7_startTransition and v7_relativeSplatPath futures to silence and prepare for v7.

rca of the issue: Substitution login failing on fresh import RCA: (1) /app/backend/.env shipped without SUB_ADMIN_USERNAME/PASSWORD → substitution.py init() skips user seeding (see line 212-217: 'if u and p:'). Reproduction: rsync fresh branch, curl POST /api/substitution/auth/login {ehtiyat, ehtiyat2026} → 401 'اسم المستخدم أو كلمة المرور غير صحيحة'. Mitigation applied: appended SUB_ADMIN_USERNAME="ehtiyat", SUB_ADMIN_PASSWORD="ehtiyat2026", JWT_SECRET="dev-secret-change-in-prod-please" to backend/.env, restarted backend. Verified db.sub_users now contains {username:'ehtiyat'} and login returns a valid JWT. Long-term fix suggestion above in critical_code_review_comments.
